hebrewText: טֶרֶם֮ יִשְׁכָּבוּ֒ וְ/אַנְשֵׁ֨י הָ/עִ֜יר אַנְשֵׁ֤י סְדֹם֙ נָסַ֣בּוּ עַל הַ/בַּ֔יִת מִ/נַּ֖עַר וְ/עַד זָקֵ֑ן כָּל הָ/עָ֖ם מִ/קָּצֶֽה

tokens.bdb: properly, non-occurrence; used adverbially, not yet or before
to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, cast down, (lover-)lay (self) (down), (make to) lie (down, down to sleep, still with), lodge, ravish, take rest, sleep, stay.

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
tokens.kjv: Ai (from margin), city, court (from margin), town.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.enLiteralWord: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanation: a city  in the widest sense
tokens.explanationEn: a city  in the widest sense

tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).

tokens.bdb: Sedom, a place near the Dead Sea
to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively
tokens.kjv: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanation: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.bdb: (concretely) a boy (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication, a servant; also (by interch. of sex), a girl (of similar latitude in age)
tokens.kjv: babe, boy, child, damsel (from the margin), lad, servant, young (man).

tokens.bdb: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
tokens.kjv: against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for(-asmuch as), (hither-) to, [phrase] how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, ([phrase] as) yet.
aged, ancient (man), elder(-est), old (man, men and...women), senator.

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock

tokens.kjv: [idiom] after, border, brim, brink, edge, end, (in-) finite, frontier, outmost coast, quarter, shore, (out-) side, [idiom] some, ut(-ter-) most (part).
